summary: Privacy-gated read-only enrichment with source-specific claims from MISP, TAXII, and Microsoft host data.
limitations: Azure application IDs support only tenant service-principal lookup; this is not a threat verdict.
TAXII complex STIX patterns and paginated collections are reported as incomplete.
Standalone portable installation requires explicit packaging of the shared COPS connector SDK.

demo.description: Exercise injected MISP, TAXII, and Microsoft responses, cache replay, conflicts, pagination, and provider failure without network access.
